recent: PMW International 近期与 TNB 签订第二份补充合约，将混凝土电杆合约价值提高至 RM148.05m，并启动位于 Sarawak Tanjung Manis 的 RM50.25m 工厂建设。公司同时与 Sarawak Timber Industry Development Corporation 签署补充协议，将先决条件期限延长至 2027 年 4 月 7 日。最新季度财报显示营收与净利均环比增长。
notable: 与 TNB 签订第二份补充合约，混凝土电杆合约价值提高至 RM148.05m。
启动位于 Sarawak Tanjung Manis 的 RM50.25m 工厂建设。
与 Sarawak Timber Industry Development Corporation 签署补充协议，将先决条件期限延长六个月至 2027 年 4 月 7 日。
risks: 与 STIDC 的协议先决条件尚未满足，期限已延长至 2027 年 4 月 7 日。

recent_en: PMW International recently signed a second supplemental contract with TNB, raising the concrete pole contract value to RM148.05m, and commenced construction of a RM50.25m factory in Tanjung Manis, Sarawak. The company also signed a supplementary agreement with Sarawak Timber Industry Development Corporation to extend the conditions precedent period to 7 April 2027. The latest quarterly results showed both revenue and net profit increased quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: Signed a second supplemental contract with TNB, raising the concrete pole contract value to RM148.05m.
Commenced construction of a RM50.25m factory in Tanjung Manis, Sarawak.
Signed a supplementary agreement with Sarawak Timber Industry Development Corporation to extend the conditions precedent period by six months to 7 April 2027.
risks_en: The conditions precedent under the agreement with STIDC have not been fulfilled, with the deadline extended to 7 April 2027.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 53.065m, up 74.9% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 4.993m, up 144.0% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 9.4%, higher than 6.7% in the previous quarter.
